seg.6a61d0d1cb9e.src: Chimmili for Nagula Chavithi ⟦1⟧(Sesame Jaggery Balls)⟦/1⟧

seg.4fea7db714b7.src: Chimmili is a small Telugu sweet of roasted sesame and jaggery, ground coarsely and rolled into balls. It is one of the offerings made on Nagula Chavithi in Karthika masam, along with chalimidi and the milk poured at the snake anthill (putta). Sesame and jaggery sweets like it are made again at Sankranti.
seg.4fea7db714b7.t: चिम्मिलि इति भृष्टतिलैः गुडेन च कृतं लघु तेलुगु-मिष्टान्नम्। तत् स्थूलतया पिष्ट्वा गोलकरूपेण वर्त्यते। कार्तिकमासे नागुल-चवित्यां यानि नैवेद्यानि अर्प्यन्ते, तेषु एतत् अन्यतमम्; तेन सह चलिमिडि, सर्पवल्मीके (पुट्ट) सिच्यमानं दुग्धं च। एतादृशानि तिलगुडमिष्टान्नानि सङ्क्रान्तौ पुनः क्रियन्ते।
seg.4fea7db714b7.back: Chimmili is a small Telugu sweet made with roasted sesame and jaggery. It is ground coarsely and rolled into the form of balls. In the month of Karthika, among the offerings (naivedya) that are offered on Nagula Chavithi, this is one; along with it, chalimidi, and milk poured into the snake mound (putta). Such sesame-jaggery sweets are made again at Sankranti.

seg.6e104d560e56.src: Roasted sesame gives it a nutty, toasty taste, and cane jaggery a caramel sweetness. The texture is soft and a little crumbly, and each ball is gone in two bites. This recipe makes about 12.
seg.6e104d560e56.t: भृष्टतिलाः अस्मै भृष्टबीजानाम् इव स्वादं यच्छन्ति, इक्षुगुडः च कैरमेल्-सदृशं माधुर्यम्। अस्य स्पर्शः मृदुः किञ्चित् भङ्गुरः च, प्रत्येकं गोलकं च द्वाभ्यां ग्रासाभ्यां समाप्यते। अनेन पाकविधिना प्रायः 12 गोलकाः भवन्ति।
seg.6e104d560e56.back: Roasted sesame gives it a taste like roasted seeds, and cane jaggery a caramel-like sweetness. Its texture is soft and a little crumbly, and each ball is finished in two mouthfuls. With this recipe about 12 balls are made.

seg.9e72f273d4f2.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the roasted sesame to cool.
seg.9e72f273d4f2.t: भृष्टतिलानां शीतलीभवनाय 5 निमेषाः अपि आहत्य-काले गणिताः।
seg.9e72f273d4f2.back: 5 minutes for the cooling of the roasted sesame are also counted in the total time.

seg.2097a0e593c6.src: Make chimmili at home: roast sesame till it crackles, grind coarsely, pulse with grated cane jaggery and cardamom, shape into balls.
seg.2097a0e593c6.t: गृहे चिम्मिलि करोतु: तिलान् चटचटाशब्दपर्यन्तं भर्जयतु, स्थूलतया पिनष्टु, घृष्टेन इक्षुगुडेन एलया च सह अल्पावर्तनैः पिनष्टु, गोलकान् रचयतु।
seg.2097a0e593c6.back: Make chimmili at home: roast the sesame until the crackling sound, grind coarsely, grind with short pulses together with grated cane jaggery and cardamom, form balls.

seg.ac56800c5ad4.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; soft jaggery binds best⟦/1⟧
seg.ac56800c5ad4.t: ¾ चषकं घृष्टः इक्षुगुडः ⟦1⟧लघु निपीड्य; मृदुः गुडः सम्यक् बध्नाति⟦/1⟧
seg.ac56800c5ad4.back: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly pressed; soft jaggery binds well⟦/1⟧

seg.39c46fb56757.src: 1 tsp ghee, for greasing your palms
seg.39c46fb56757.back: 1 small spoon ghee, for smearing on the palms

seg.ed775cba4fcf.src: Grate the jaggery and measure out the sesame before you start; once the sesame is roasted, the rest moves quickly.
seg.ed775cba4fcf.t: आरम्भात् पूर्वं गुडं घर्षयतु तिलान् च मापयतु; तिलेषु भृष्टेषु शेषं कार्यं शीघ्रं प्रचलति।
seg.ed775cba4fcf.back: Before the start, grate the jaggery and measure the sesame; when the sesame is roasted the remaining work proceeds quickly.

seg.cfb9d281b47f.src: Heat a heavy kadai or pan on low heat for a minute. Add the sesame; no oil or ghee is needed.
seg.cfb9d281b47f.t: स्थूलं कटाहं पात्रं वा मन्दाग्नौ एकं निमेषं तापयतु। तिलान् योजयतु; तैलस्य घृतस्य वा आवश्यकता नास्ति।
seg.cfb9d281b47f.back: Heat a thick kadai or vessel on low fire for one minute. Add the sesame; there is no need for oil or ghee.

seg.89a51ce5355c.src: Dry-roast the sesame on a low flame till it crackles and turns light golden. Stir all the time; the seeds start to pop and smell nutty after 4–6 minutes. Do not let them turn brown.
seg.89a51ce5355c.t: तिलान् तैलं विना मन्दाग्नौ भर्जयतु, यावत् ते चटचटायन्ते ईषत्-स्वर्णवर्णाः च भवन्ति। सततं चालयतु; 4–6 निमेषेभ्यः अनन्तरं बीजानि स्फुटन्ति भृष्टबीजगन्धं च प्रसारयन्ति। तानि पिङ्गलवर्णानि मा भवन्तु।
seg.89a51ce5355c.back: Roast the sesame without oil on low fire, until they crackle and become slightly golden-coloured. Stir constantly; after 4–6 minutes the seeds burst and spread a roasted-seed smell. Let them not become tawny-brown in colour.

seg.999792547560.src: Tip the sesame onto a wide plate straight away so it stops browning. Cool it for about 5 minutes, until it is just warm to the touch.
seg.999792547560.t: तिलान् तत्क्षणम् एव विशालायां स्थाल्यां पातयतु, येन तेषां वर्णः अधिकं न श्यामायेत। प्रायः 5 निमेषान् शीतलीकरोतु, यावत् ते स्पर्शे केवलम् ईषदुष्णाः भवन्ति।
seg.999792547560.back: Immediately pour the sesame onto a wide plate, so that their colour does not darken more. Cool for about 5 minutes, until they are only slightly warm to the touch.

seg.77b614ea2f92.src: Grind the sesame coarsely in short pulses. Use the small jar of the mixer and pulse 3–4 times, a second or two at a time; stop while you can still see broken seeds.
seg.77b614ea2f92.t: तिलान् अल्पावर्तनैः स्थूलतया पिनष्टु। मिश्रकयन्त्रस्य लघुपात्रं प्रयुज्य 3–4 वारं, प्रतिवारम् एकं द्वौ वा क्षणौ, चालयतु; यावत् भग्नबीजानि दृश्यन्ते तावत् एव स्थगयतु।
seg.77b614ea2f92.back: Grind the sesame coarsely with short pulses. Using the small jar of the mixer machine, run it 3–4 times, one or two seconds each time; stop just while broken seeds are visible.

seg.175aeced5810.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom; pulse till it comes together. This takes 4–6 more short pulses; scrape down the sides once. A pinch pressed between your fingers should hold its shape.
seg.175aeced5810.t: गुडम् एलां च योजयतु; मिश्रणं यावत् संयुज्यते तावत् आवर्तयतु। अस्मै 4–6 अधिकानि अल्पावर्तनानि आवश्यकानि; एकवारं पार्श्वेभ्यः मिश्रणम् अधः कर्षतु। अङ्गुलिभ्यां निपीडितं चिटिकामात्रं स्वाकारं धारयेत्।
seg.175aeced5810.back: Add the jaggery and cardamom; pulse until the mixture comes together. For this 4–6 more short pulses are needed; once, pull the mixture down from the sides. A pinch-quantity pressed with two fingers should hold its own shape.

seg.6f94cb46b9ab.src: If the mixture is too dry to hold, add 1–2 tsp more grated jaggery and pulse once or twice again.
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.t: यदि मिश्रणम् अतिशुष्कत्वात् न बध्यते, तर्हि 1–2 लघुचमसौ अधिकं घृष्टगुडं योजयित्वा पुनः एकं द्वौ वा वारौ आवर्तयतु।
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.back: If the mixture does not bind because of being too dry, then add 1–2 small spoons more grated jaggery and pulse again once or twice.

seg.226f137c9449.src: Tip the mixture into a bowl and grease your palms lightly with ghee.
seg.226f137c9449.t: मिश्रणं पात्रे पातयतु, करतलौ च घृतेन लघु लेपयतु।
seg.226f137c9449.back: Pour the mixture into a vessel, and lightly smear the palms with ghee.

seg.ff3eb71729c2.src: Shape into small balls. Take a heaped tablespoon at a time, press it firmly in your fist, then roll it smooth. Work quickly while the mixture is still warm, as it turns crumbly when it cools.
seg.ff3eb71729c2.t: लघुगोलकान् रचयतु। प्रतिवारम् एकं पूर्णं महाचमसं गृहीत्वा मुष्टौ दृढं निपीडयतु, ततः मसृणं वर्तयतु। मिश्रणे उष्णे सति एव शीघ्रं कार्यं करोतु, यतः शीतलं सत् तत् भङ्गुरं भवति।
seg.ff3eb71729c2.back: Form small balls. Each time take one full big spoon, press firmly in the fist, then roll smooth. Work quickly only while the mixture is warm, because when cold it becomes crumbly.

seg.ee9e027268aa.src: Leave the balls on a plate until they cool completely, about 15 minutes, then store them in an airtight jar.
seg.ee9e027268aa.t: गोलकान् स्थाल्यां स्थापयतु यावत् ते पूर्णतया शीतलाः भवन्ति, प्रायः 15 निमेषान्, ततः तान् वायुरोधके पात्रे स्थापयतु।
seg.ee9e027268aa.back: Place the balls on a plate until they become fully cool, about 15 minutes, then put them in an airtight vessel.

seg.7fe633314020.src: Roast on a low flame and keep stirring; sesame goes from golden to burnt quickly, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.
seg.7fe633314020.t: मन्दाग्नौ भर्जयतु सततं च चालयतु; तिलाः स्वर्णवर्णात् शीघ्रं दग्धाः भवन्ति, दग्धतिलाः च तिक्ताः लगन्ति।
seg.7fe633314020.back: Roast on low fire and stir constantly; sesame quickly becomes burnt from golden colour, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.

seg.d50b37351252.src: Grind in short pulses only; long runs turn sesame into an oily paste.
seg.d50b37351252.t: अल्पावर्तनैः एव पिनष्टु; दीर्घकालं चालनेन तिलाः तैलयुक्तं पिष्टं भवन्ति।
seg.d50b37351252.back: Grind only with short pulses; by running for a long time the sesame becomes an oily paste.

seg.75f5428655c4.src: Shape while the mixture is warm. If it turns crumbly, pulse it once more with a teaspoon of grated jaggery.
seg.75f5428655c4.t: मिश्रणे उष्णे सति एव आकारं ददातु। यदि तत् भङ्गुरं भवति, तर्हि एकेन लघुचमसेन घृष्टगुडेन सह पुनः एकवारम् आवर्तयतु।
seg.75f5428655c4.back: Give shape only while the mixture is warm. If it becomes crumbly, then pulse once more with one small spoon of grated jaggery.

seg.1d42a24453d2.src: Soft jaggery binds best. If yours is hard, grate it finely so it blends in evenly.
seg.1d42a24453d2.t: मृदुः गुडः सम्यक् बध्नाति। यदि भवतः गुडः कठिनः, तर्हि तं सूक्ष्मं घर्षयतु येन सः समानतया मिश्र्येत।
seg.1d42a24453d2.back: Soft jaggery binds well. If your jaggery is hard, then grate it fine so that it mixes evenly.

seg.5a7ed16f4810.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker chimmili with a smoky sweetness.
seg.5a7ed16f4810.t: तालगुडः: तावतः एव घृष्टतालगुडस्य उपयोगं करोतु; चिम्मिलि श्यामतरं भवति, तस्य माधुर्ये च ईषत् धूमस्वादः।
seg.5a7ed16f4810.back: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the chimmili becomes darker, and in its sweetness there is a slight smoky taste.

seg.569a63f3cd17.src: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): roast and grind it the same way for darker, stronger-tasting balls.
seg.569a63f3cd17.t: कृष्णतिलाः (नल्ल नुव्वुलु): तान् अपि तथैव भर्जयित्वा पिनष्टु; गोलकाः श्यामतराः तीव्रतरस्वादाः च भवन्ति।
seg.569a63f3cd17.back: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): roast and grind them too in the same way; the balls become darker and of stronger taste.

seg.da0d1a9b6378.src: Peanut or coconut: pulse in 2 tbsp roasted peanuts or grated dry coconut with the jaggery.
seg.da0d1a9b6378.t: भूचणकाः नारिकेलं वा: गुडेन सह 2 महाचमसान् भृष्टभूचणकान् घृष्टशुष्कनारिकेलं वा आवर्तयतु।
seg.da0d1a9b6378.back: Groundnuts or coconut: pulse 2 big spoons of roasted groundnuts or grated dry coconut with the jaggery.

seg.32d41fc0994e.src: Without a mixer: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu) until the mixture holds, then shape.
seg.32d41fc0994e.t: मिश्रकयन्त्रं विना: उष्णतिलान् गुडं च पाषाणोलूखले (रोलु) सह कुट्टयतु यावत् मिश्रणं बध्यते, ततः आकारं ददातु।
seg.32d41fc0994e.back: Without a mixer machine: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu) until the mixture binds, then give shape.

seg.2fa9aaef4425.src: On Nagula Chavithi morning, offer chimmili with milk at the snake anthill (putta) or in your puja, then share them as prasadam. They also go well with evening tea.
seg.2fa9aaef4425.t: नागुल-चवित्याः प्रातःकाले सर्पवल्मीके (पुट्ट) भवतः पूजायां वा दुग्धेन सह चिम्मिलि अर्पयतु, ततः प्रसादरूपेण वितरतु। सायङ्काले चायेन सह अपि तत् रोचते।
seg.2fa9aaef4425.back: On the morning of Nagula Chavithi, offer the chimmili with milk at the snake mound (putta) or in your puja, then distribute it as prasad. In the evening it is also enjoyed with tea.

seg.bd50831bbb3f.src: Keeps a week in an airtight jar. Store the jar at room temperature, in a dry place.
seg.bd50831bbb3f.t: वायुरोधके पात्रे एकसप्ताहं तिष्ठति। पात्रं कक्षतापमाने शुष्के स्थाने स्थापयतु।
seg.bd50831bbb3f.back: It stays for one week in an airtight vessel. Keep the vessel at room temperature in a dry place.

seg.4023b0de08bd.src: Why is my chimmili not holding together?
seg.4023b0de08bd.back: Why does my chimmili not bind?

seg.7fed90d1ebe0.src: The sesame may be under-ground, or the mixture may have cooled. Pulse it once more with 1–2 tsp extra grated jaggery and shape it while it is still warm.
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.t: तिलाः सम्यक् न पिष्टाः स्युः, अथवा मिश्रणं शीतलं जातं स्यात्। 1–2 लघुचमसमितेन अधिकघृष्टगुडेन सह पुनः एकवारम् आवर्तयतु, उष्णे सति एव आकारं ददातु।
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.back: The sesame may not have been ground properly, or the mixture may have become cold. Pulse once more with 1–2 small spoons of extra grated jaggery, and give shape only while warm.

seg.694d2b416f39.src: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?
seg.694d2b416f39.back: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?

seg.d0ee77d0957e.src: The sesame was roasted too dark. Roast it on a low flame only until it crackles and turns light golden, then tip it onto a plate at once so it stops browning.
seg.d0ee77d0957e.t: तिलाः अतिश्यामं भृष्टाः। मन्दाग्नौ एव भर्जयतु, यावत् ते चटचटायन्ते ईषत्-स्वर्णवर्णाः च भवन्ति, ततः तत्क्षणं स्थाल्यां पातयतु येन वर्णः अधिकं न श्यामायेत।
seg.d0ee77d0957e.back: The sesame was roasted too dark. Roast only on low fire, until they crackle and become slightly golden, then immediately pour onto a plate so that the colour does not darken more.

seg.30d31a37acfa.src: Can I use palm jaggery instead of cane jaggery?
seg.30d31a37acfa.t: इक्षुगुडस्य स्थाने तालगुडस्य उपयोगं कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.30d31a37acfa.back: Can I use palm jaggery in place of cane jaggery?

seg.77afe99f558c.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The chimmili will be darker, with a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.77afe99f558c.t: आम्। तावतः एव घृष्टतालगुडस्य (ताटि बेल्लम) उपयोगं करोतु। चिम्मिलि श्यामतरं भविष्यति, तस्य माधुर्यं च गभीरतरम् ईषत्-धूमस्वादयुक्तं च।
seg.77afe99f558c.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The chimmili will be darker, and its sweetness deeper and with a slight smoky taste.

seg.bae4fc214e74.src: Nagula Chavithi falls on Friday, 13 November 2026, in Karthika masam, a few days after Deepavali. Chimmili, chalimidi and milk are among the offerings made at the snake anthill (putta) that morning.
seg.bae4fc214e74.t: नागुल-चवितिः 2026 तमस्य वर्षस्य नवम्बर-मासस्य 13 दिनाङ्के शुक्रवासरे अस्ति, कार्तिकमासे, दीपावल्याः कतिपयदिनेभ्यः अनन्तरम्। तस्मिन् प्रातःकाले सर्पवल्मीके (पुट्ट) अर्प्यमाणेषु नैवेद्येषु चिम्मिलि, चलिमिडि, दुग्धं च सन्ति।
seg.bae4fc214e74.back: Nagula Chavithi is on Friday, the 13th day of the month of November of the year 2026, in the month of Karthika, some days after Deepavali. Among the offerings being offered at the snake mound (putta) that morning are chimmili, chalimidi and milk.

seg.4b090c2ce3d3.src: Filter coffee is how many Telugu homes start the day: a strong decoction dripped through a steel filter, topped up with hot milk and frothed between a tumbler and davara. This version is sweetened with grated palm jaggery (thati bellam) in place of sugar.
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.t: बहुषु तेलुगु-गृहेषु दिनस्य आरम्भः फिल्टर-काफ्या भवति: स्टील्-फिल्टर-द्वारा बिन्दुशः स्रुतः तीव्रः क्वाथः, उष्णदुग्धेन पूरितः, टम्ब्लर-दवरयोः मध्ये फेनायितः च। अस्मिन् प्रकारे शर्करायाः स्थाने घृष्टतालगुडेन (ताटि बेल्लम) माधुर्यं दीयते।
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.back: In many Telugu homes the start of the day happens with filter coffee: strong decoction dripped drop by drop through a steel filter, filled up with hot milk, and frothed between tumbler and dabara. In this variety, sweetness is given with grated palm jaggery (tati bellam) in place of sugar.

seg.cff6d2079da1.src: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoky caramel sweetness that sits well with the bitterness of the decoction. Once the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it suits a slow morning as much as an evening break.
seg.cff6d2079da1.t: तालगुडः चषकाय गभीरम् ईषत्-धूमस्वादयुक्तं कैरमेल्-माधुर्यं ददाति, यत् क्वाथस्य तिक्ततया सह सम्यक् सङ्गच्छते। क्वाथे सिद्धे सति प्रायः 5 निमेषाः लगन्ति, एतत् च मन्दगतेः प्रातःकालस्य इव सायङ्कालीनविरामस्य अपि उपयुक्तम्।
seg.cff6d2079da1.back: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoky caramel sweetness, which goes well with the bitterness of the decoction. When the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and this is suitable for a slow-paced morning as well as for an evening break.

seg.814efc526088.src: 5 minutes if your decoction is already made.
seg.814efc526088.t: यदि क्वाथः पूर्वम् एव सिद्धः, तर्हि 5 निमेषाः।
seg.814efc526088.back: If the decoction is already ready, then 5 minutes.

seg.9ad0a1e24d76.src: Boil the milk, add it to the decoction, then stir in grated palm jaggery off the heat. Froth it between tumbler and davara.
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.t: दुग्धं क्वाथयतु, क्वाथे योजयतु, ततः अग्नेः अवतार्य घृष्टतालगुडं मिश्रयतु। टम्ब्लर-दवरयोः मध्ये पातयित्वा फेनं जनयतु।
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.back: Boil the milk, add it to the decoction, then take it down from the fire and mix in the grated palm jaggery. Pour between tumbler and dabara to create froth.

seg.927b924ff51d.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧enough decoction for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.back: 2 big spoons filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧decoction enough for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.8aa60818ccf8.src: ½ cup water, just off the boil
seg.8aa60818ccf8.t: ½ चषकं जलम्, क्वथनात् सद्यः अवतारितम्
seg.8aa60818ccf8.back: ½ cup water, just taken down from boiling

seg.95409b9d346e.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧from above; 3 tbsp for a stronger cup⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.back: 2 big spoons filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧from the one mentioned above; 3 big spoons for a stronger cup⟦/1⟧

seg.7b8c0f7e922a.back: 1–2 small spoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.95d91fecafcb.src: Make the decoction: put 2 tbsp filter coffee powder in the top chamber of a South Indian coffee filter, set the perforated press on it and pour in ½ cup water just off the boil. Cover and leave it to drip for 10–15 minutes.
seg.95d91fecafcb.t: क्वाथं करोतु: दक्षिणभारतीय-काफी-फिल्टरस्य उपरिभागे 2 महाचमसौ फिल्टर-काफी-चूर्णं स्थापयतु, तस्य उपरि सच्छिद्रं निपीडकं निधाय क्वथनात् सद्यः अवतारितं ½ चषकं जलं पातयतु। आच्छाद्य 10–15 निमेषान् बिन्दुशः स्रवितुं त्यजतु।
seg.95d91fecafcb.back: Make the decoction: put 2 big spoons of filter coffee powder in the upper part of a South Indian coffee filter, place the perforated presser on top of it and pour ½ cup of water just taken down from boiling. Cover and leave it to drip drop by drop for 10–15 minutes.

seg.9024c8716b54.src: While it drips, grate the palm jaggery finely so it dissolves in seconds.
seg.9024c8716b54.t: यावत् तत् स्रवति, तावत् तालगुडं सूक्ष्मं घर्षयतु येन सः क्षणेषु विलीयेत।
seg.9024c8716b54.back: While it drips, grate the palm jaggery fine so that it dissolves in moments.

seg.24689e3dd311.src: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and set it on medium heat.
seg.24689e3dd311.back: Pour the milk into a small pan and place it on medium fire.

seg.4d8e3042dc81.src: Bring the milk to a boil. As soon as it froths up the sides of the pan, switch off the heat.
seg.4d8e3042dc81.t: दुग्धं क्वाथयतु। यदा एव तत् फेनायमानं स्थाल्याः पार्श्वेषु उद्गच्छति, तदा अग्निं निर्वापयतु।
seg.4d8e3042dc81.back: Boil the milk. Just when it rises foaming at the sides of the pan, put out the fire.

seg.a124a0d34983.src: Pour the decoction into a tumbler and add the hot milk. Use 2 tbsp decoction for a mild cup and 3 tbsp for a strong one.
seg.a124a0d34983.t: क्वाथं टम्ब्लरे पातयित्वा उष्णदुग्धं योजयतु। मृदुचषकाय 2 महाचमसौ क्वाथं, तीव्रचषकाय च 3 महाचमसान् उपयोजयतु।
seg.a124a0d34983.back: Pour the decoction into a tumbler and add the hot milk. Use 2 big spoons of decoction for a mild cup, and 3 big spoons for a strong cup.

seg.85570720618b.src: Let it stand for about a minute, so the milk is just off the boil.
seg.85570720618b.t: प्रायः एकं निमेषं तिष्ठतु, येन दुग्धं क्वथनात् किञ्चित् न्यूनतापं भवेत्।
seg.85570720618b.back: Let it stand about one minute, so that the milk becomes a little lower in heat than boiling.

seg.eacea0d7cf43.src: Stir in the palm jaggery off the heat. Keep stirring for 20–30 seconds, until no grains are left at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.eacea0d7cf43.t: अग्नेः दूरे तालगुडं मिश्रयतु। 20–30 क्षणान् यावत् चालयतु, यावत् टम्ब्लर-तले कणाः न अवशिष्यन्ते।
seg.eacea0d7cf43.back: Away from the fire, mix in the palm jaggery. Stir for 20–30 seconds, until no grains remain at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.08b600da2ef8.src: Taste, and add a little more jaggery if you like it sweeter.
seg.08b600da2ef8.t: आस्वाद्य, यदि अधिकं मधुरम् इच्छति तर्हि किञ्चित् अधिकं गुडं योजयतु।
seg.08b600da2ef8.back: Having tasted, if you want it sweeter, then add a little more jaggery.

seg.878b0d8d7eeb.src: Pour between tumbler and davara to froth. Hold the tumbler high and pour into the davara, then back again, 3–4 times, until a light foam sits on top.
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.t: फेनाय टम्ब्लर-दवरयोः मध्ये पातयतु। टम्ब्लरम् उच्चैः धृत्वा दवरायां पातयतु, ततः पुनः प्रतिपातयतु, 3–4 वारं, यावत् उपरि लघुः फेनः तिष्ठति।
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.back: For froth, pour between tumbler and dabara. Holding the tumbler high, pour into the dabara, then pour back again, 3–4 times, until a light froth stays on top.

seg.653390b95f57.src: Serve straight away, in the tumbler set inside the davara.
seg.653390b95f57.back: Serve immediately, in the tumbler placed in the dabara.

seg.33aca43ebf99.src: Add jaggery after the milk is off the boil so it does not split.
seg.33aca43ebf99.t: दुग्धे क्वथनात् अवतारिते एव गुडं योजयतु, येन तत् न भिद्येत।
seg.33aca43ebf99.back: Add the jaggery only when the milk has been taken off boiling, so that it does not split.

seg.60404da43771.src: Grate the jaggery finely: fine shreds dissolve in seconds, while lumps sink and stay at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.60404da43771.t: गुडं सूक्ष्मं घर्षयतु: सूक्ष्मखण्डाः क्षणेषु विलीयन्ते, किन्तु पिण्डाः निमज्ज्य टम्ब्लर-तले तिष्ठन्ति।
seg.60404da43771.back: Grate the jaggery fine: fine pieces dissolve in moments, but lumps sink and stay at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.ca883342300e.src: Palm jaggery has a deep, slightly smoky sweetness, so start with 1 tsp and add more to taste.
seg.ca883342300e.t: तालगुडस्य माधुर्यं गभीरम् ईषत्-धूमस्वादयुक्तं च, अतः 1 लघुचमसेन आरभ्य रुच्यनुसारम् अधिकं योजयतु।
seg.ca883342300e.back: The sweetness of palm jaggery is deep and with a slight smoky taste, so starting with 1 small spoon, add more according to taste.

seg.d7c0084f5cc6.src: A steel tumbler and davara keep the coffee hot and make frothing easy; a mug and a jug work too.
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.t: स्टील्-टम्ब्लरं दवरा च काफीम् उष्णां रक्षतः फेनकरणं च सुकरं कुरुतः; मग्-पात्रं जग्-पात्रं च अपि उपयुक्ते।
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.back: A steel tumbler and dabara keep the coffee hot and make frothing easy; a mug vessel and jug vessel are also suitable.

seg.1b917ac5fc8c.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.t: इक्षुगुडः: लघुतरस्य कैरमेल्-सदृशस्य माधुर्यस्य कृते तावन्तम् एव घृष्टम् इक्षुगुडम् उपयोजयतु।
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.back: Cane jaggery: for a lighter caramel-like sweetness, use the same amount of grated cane jaggery.

seg.0ada954bebfe.src: Palm jaggery tea: make your usual milk tea, switch off the heat, wait a minute, then stir in the palm jaggery the same way.
seg.0ada954bebfe.t: तालगुड-चायम्: भवतः सामान्यं दुग्धचायं कृत्वा अग्निं निर्वाप्य एकं निमेषं प्रतीक्ष्य, ततः तथैव तालगुडं मिश्रयतु।
seg.0ada954bebfe.back: Palm jaggery tea: having made your usual milk tea, putting out the fire, waiting one minute, then mix in palm jaggery in the same way.

seg.6512d133d4c0.src: No coffee filter: dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water and use it in place of the decoction.
seg.6512d133d4c0.t: काफी-फिल्टरः नास्ति चेत्: 1 लघुचमसं तात्क्षणिक-काफी-चूर्णं 2 महाचमसमिते उष्णजले विलाप्य क्वाथस्य स्थाने उपयोजयतु।
seg.6512d133d4c0.back: If there is no coffee filter: dissolve 1 small spoon of instant coffee powder in 2 big spoons of hot water and use it in place of the decoction.

seg.e9e80ce83cf6.src: Serve hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.t: इडली, दोसा, उपमा वा इति प्रातराशात् अनन्तरम् उष्णं परिवेषयतु, अथवा सायङ्काले बिस्कुटैः मुरुकुलुभिः वा सह।
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.back: Serve hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.

seg.97817ad1f29f.src: Make each cup as you need it; coffee reheated after the jaggery goes in can split. Keep extra decoction covered at room temperature and use it within the day.
seg.97817ad1f29f.t: प्रतिचषकम् आवश्यकतानुसारं करोतु; गुडयोजनानन्तरं पुनस्तापिता काफी भिद्येत। अवशिष्टं क्वाथम् आच्छाद्य कक्षतापमाने स्थापयतु, तस्मिन् एव दिने उपयोजयतु च।
seg.97817ad1f29f.back: Make each cup as needed; coffee reheated after adding jaggery may split. Cover the leftover decoction, keep it at room temperature, and use it on that same day.

seg.ea4f4072538a.src: Why did my coffee curdle when I added palm jaggery?
seg.ea4f4072538a.t: तालगुडे योजिते मम काफी किमर्थं भिन्ना?
seg.ea4f4072538a.back: Why did my coffee split when palm jaggery was added?

seg.180a2670ead3.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Take the milk off the heat, let it stand for about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.180a2670ead3.t: क्वथमाने दुग्धे मिश्रितः गुडः तत् भेत्तुं शक्नोति। दुग्धम् अग्नेः अवतार्य प्रायः एकं निमेषं तिष्ठतु, ततः घृष्टगुडं मिश्रयतु।
seg.180a2670ead3.back: Jaggery mixed into boiling milk can split it. Take the milk down from the fire and let it stand about one minute, then mix in the grated jaggery.

seg.2b9449407096.src: Can I use cane jaggery instead of palm jaggery?
seg.2b9449407096.t: तालगुडस्य स्थाने इक्षुगुडस्य उपयोगं कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.2b9449407096.back: Can I use cane jaggery in place of palm jaggery?

seg.890ae3e15593.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery. The coffee tastes lighter and more like caramel, while palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky cup.
seg.890ae3e15593.t: आम्। तावन्तम् एव घृष्टम् इक्षुगुडम् उपयोजयतु। काफ्याः स्वादः लघुतरः कैरमेल्-सदृशतरः च भवति, तालगुडः तु गभीरतरम् ईषत्-धूमस्वादयुक्तं चषकं ददाति।
seg.890ae3e15593.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery. The coffee's taste becomes lighter and more caramel-like, whereas palm jaggery gives a deeper cup with a slight smoky taste.

seg.e4c92d1c8a42.src: How much palm jaggery should I add to one cup of coffee?
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.back: How much palm jaggery should be added to one cup of coffee?

seg.43a5dfb10340.src: 1 to 2 tsp of grated palm jaggery for 1 cup of milk and 2 tbsp of decoction. Start with 1 tsp, taste, and add more if you like.
seg.43a5dfb10340.t: 1 चषकदुग्धाय 2 महाचमसक्वाथाय च 1 तः 2 लघुचमसाः घृष्टतालगुडः। 1 लघुचमसेन आरभ्य आस्वाद्य, इच्छति चेत् अधिकं योजयतु।
seg.43a5dfb10340.back: 1 to 2 small spoons of grated palm jaggery for 1 cup of milk and 2 big spoons of decoction. Starting with 1 small spoon, having tasted, add more if you wish.

seg.2ba4fb9452bb.src: Can I make palm jaggery coffee without a coffee filter?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.t: काफी-फिल्टरं विना तालगुड-काफीं कर्तुं शक्नोमि किम्?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.back: Can I make palm jaggery coffee without a coffee filter?

seg.23f63da2d908.src: Yes. Dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water, use it in place of the decoction and follow the same steps.
seg.23f63da2d908.t: आम्। 1 लघुचमसं तात्क्षणिक-काफी-चूर्णं 2 महाचमसमिते उष्णजले विलाप्य क्वाथस्य स्थाने उपयोजयतु, तान् एव सोपानान् अनुसरतु च।
seg.23f63da2d908.back: Yes. Dissolve 1 small spoon of instant coffee powder in 2 big spoons of hot water and use it in place of the decoction, and follow the same steps.

seg.1143d51ba236.src: Paramannam is the rice-and-milk sweet that Telugu homes cook for festivals and pujas: rice simmered slowly in milk until soft and creamy, then sweetened. Bellam paramannam, made with jaggery, is a common naivedyam at Diwali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratham, offered at the puja and then shared at the festive meal.
seg.1143d51ba236.t: परमान्नं नाम तण्डुलदुग्धयोः मिष्टान्नम्, यत् तेलुगु-गृहेषु उत्सवेषु पूजासु च पच्यते: तण्डुलाः दुग्धे मन्दं मन्दं पच्यन्ते यावत् मृदवः घनाः च भवन्ति, ततः मधुरीक्रियन्ते। गुडेन कृतं बेल्लम परमान्नं दीपावल्यां, सङ्क्रान्तौ, वरलक्ष्मीव्रते च सामान्यं नैवेद्यम्; पूजायाम् अर्प्यते, ततः उत्सवभोजने वितीर्यते।
seg.1143d51ba236.back: Paramannam is a sweet of rice and milk, which is cooked in Telugu homes at festivals and pujas: the rice is cooked slowly in milk until it becomes soft and thick, then it is sweetened. Bellam paramannam made with jaggery is a common offering (naivedya) at Deepavali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratam; it is offered in the puja, then distributed at the festival meal.

seg.360051f42785.src: Cane jaggery turns it a light caramel colour and gives a rounder, toffee-like sweetness. Ghee-fried cashews and a little cardamom finish it. This recipe serves 4.
seg.360051f42785.t: इक्षुगुडः एतत् लघु-कैरमेल्-वर्णं करोति, पूर्णतरं टॉफी-सदृशं माधुर्यं च ददाति। घृते भृष्टानि काजूतकानि किञ्चित् एला च एतत् समापयन्ति। अनेन पाकविधिना 4 जनेभ्यः पर्याप्तं भवति।
seg.360051f42785.back: Cane jaggery makes it a light caramel colour, and gives a fuller toffee-like sweetness. Cashews roasted in ghee and a little cardamom finish it. With this recipe it is enough for 4 people.

seg.04a51f6c83e4.src: Total includes the 5-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.04a51f6c83e4.t: गुडयोजनात् पूर्वं 5 निमेषाणां विश्रामः अपि आहत्य-काले गणितः।
seg.04a51f6c83e4.back: A rest of 5 minutes before adding the jaggery is also counted in the total time.

seg.fd8f49fce13b.src: Cook rice in milk till creamy, rest it 5 minutes, then stir in grated cane jaggery. Finish with ghee-fried cashews and cardamom.
seg.fd8f49fce13b.t: तण्डुलान् दुग्धे घनत्वपर्यन्तं पचतु, 5 निमेषान् विश्रमयतु, ततः घृष्टम् इक्षुगुडं मिश्रयतु। घृते भृष्टैः काजूतकैः एलया च समापयतु।
seg.fd8f49fce13b.back: Cook the rice in milk until thick, let it rest 5 minutes, then mix in grated cane jaggery. Finish with cashews roasted in ghee and cardamom.

seg.1c0f194a4451.src: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori or another short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.t: ½ चषकं तण्डुलाः ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी अथवा अन्ये ह्रस्वकणतण्डुलाः, प्रायः 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.back: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori or other short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.8f34922ee281.src: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; whole milk gives the creamiest result⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.t: 4 चषकाणि दुग्धम् ⟦1⟧प्रायः 1 लीटर्; पूर्णवसायुक्तेन दुग्धेन सर्वाधिकं घनं परमान्नं भवति⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.back: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; with full-fat milk the thickest paramannam is made⟦/1⟧

seg.ee0c3b96837f.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; up to 2 tbsp more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.t: ¾ चषकं घृष्टः इक्षुगुडः ⟦1⟧लघु निपीड्य; अधिकं माधुर्यम् इच्छति चेत् 2 महाचमसपर्यन्तम् अधिकम्⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.back: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly pressed; if you want more sweetness, up to 2 big spoons more⟦/1⟧

seg.fa014766d2bf.src: ½ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 4–5 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.back: ½ small spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the pounded seeds of 4–5 cardamom pods⟦/1⟧

seg.480e0a7d227f.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water until the water runs almost clear, then drain it well.
seg.480e0a7d227f.t: तण्डुलान् 2–3 वारं जलं परिवर्त्य प्रक्षालयतु यावत् जलं प्रायः पारदर्शकं भवति, ततः सम्यक् जलं निःसारयतु।
seg.480e0a7d227f.back: Wash the rice, changing the water 2–3 times, until the water becomes almost transparent, then drain out the water well.

seg.d5b0fc46818a.src: Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed pan and bring it to a boil on medium heat, about 8–10 minutes. Stir now and then so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.d5b0fc46818a.t: दुग्धं स्थूलतलायां स्थाल्यां पातयित्वा मध्यमाग्नौ क्वाथयतु, प्रायः 8–10 निमेषान्। मध्ये मध्ये चालयतु येन तत् तले न लगेत्।
seg.d5b0fc46818a.back: Pour the milk into a thick-bottomed pan and boil it on medium fire, about 8–10 minutes. Stir now and then so that it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b8f9c8c6758b.src: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and turn the heat to low.
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.t: जलनिःसारितान् तण्डुलान् क्वथमाने दुग्धे योजयित्वा अग्निं मन्दं करोतु।
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.back: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and make the fire low.

seg.9ae9baab76d7.src: Cook the washed rice in the milk on a low flame till soft and creamy, about 30 minutes. Stir often, scraping the bottom and sides of the pan each time.
seg.9ae9baab76d7.t: प्रक्षालितान् तण्डुलान् दुग्धे मन्दाग्नौ पचतु यावत् ते मृदवः घनाः च भवन्ति, प्रायः 30 निमेषान्। पुनः पुनः चालयतु, प्रतिवारं स्थाल्याः तलं पार्श्वान् च चमसेन कर्षन्।
seg.9ae9baab76d7.back: Cook the washed rice in the milk on low fire until they become soft and thick, about 30 minutes. Stir again and again, each time scraping the bottom and sides of the pan with a spoon.

seg.ec1509a08b4c.src: Check the rice: a grain should mash easily between your fingers, and the milk should have thickened slightly. For a creamier paramannam, lightly mash a few grains against the side of the pan.
seg.ec1509a08b4c.t: तण्डुलान् परीक्षताम्: एकः कणः अङ्गुलिभ्यां सुकरं मर्दनीयः स्यात्, दुग्धं च किञ्चित् घनीभूतं स्यात्। अधिकघनाय परमान्नाय कतिपयान् कणान् स्थाल्याः पार्श्वे लघु मर्दयतु।
seg.ec1509a08b4c.back: Test the rice: one grain should be easily crushable between two fingers, and the milk should be somewhat thickened. For a thicker paramannam, lightly crush some grains at the side of the pan.

seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.src: Switch off and let it rest 5 minutes. This brings the milk below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.t: अग्निं निर्वाप्य 5 निमेषान् विश्रमयतु। अनेन दुग्धं क्वथनात् न्यूनतापं भवति, अतः गुडः तत् न भेत्स्यति।
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.back: Put out the fire and let it rest 5 minutes. By this the milk becomes lower in heat than boiling, so the jaggery will not split it.

seg.ca16c98d9b18.src: Stir in the jaggery till it melts, about 1–2 minutes, keeping the pan off the heat.
seg.ca16c98d9b18.t: स्थालीम् अग्नेः दूरे धृत्वा गुडं मिश्रयतु यावत् सः विलीयते, प्रायः 1–2 निमेषान्।
seg.ca16c98d9b18.back: Holding the pan away from the fire, mix in the jaggery until it dissolves, about 1–2 minutes.

seg.74412a8cc141.src: Taste, and stir in a little more grated jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.74412a8cc141.t: आस्वाद्य, अधिकं मधुरम् इच्छति चेत् किञ्चित् अधिकं घृष्टगुडं मिश्रयतु।
seg.74412a8cc141.back: Having tasted, if you want it sweeter, mix in a little more grated jaggery.

seg.92b56df40ea6.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat.
seg.92b56df40ea6.back: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium-low fire.

seg.1bb1f411e4d0.src: Fry the cashews in ghee; add with the cardamom. Stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up. Pour the nuts and ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and stir.
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.t: काजूतकानि घृते भर्जयतु; एलया सह योजयतु। काजूतकानि स्वर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं चालयतु, प्रायः 1 निमेषम्, अन्तिमेषु कतिपयक्षणेषु शुष्कद्राक्षाः योजयतु यावत् ताः स्फीताः भवन्ति। काजूतकानि घृतं च परमान्ने पातयतु, एलाचूर्णं प्रकिरतु, चालयतु च।
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.back: Roast the cashews in ghee; add with cardamom. Stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute; in the last few moments add the raisins until they become swollen. Pour the cashews and ghee into the paramannam, scatter the cardamom powder, and stir.

seg.e10b7192c157.src: Serve warm. Paramannam thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, if needed.
seg.e10b7192c157.t: उष्णं परिवेषयतु। स्थितं परमान्नं घनीभवति; आवश्यकं चेत् अग्नेः दूरे कतिपयचमसमितेन उष्णदुग्धेन तत् तरलीकरोतु।
seg.e10b7192c157.back: Serve warm. Paramannam that stands becomes thick; if needed, make it liquid away from the fire with a few spoonfuls of warm milk.

seg.d30196cf6b28.src: Jaggery goes in off the heat so the milk does not split.
seg.d30196cf6b28.t: गुडः अग्नेः दूरे योज्यते येन दुग्धं न भिद्येत।
seg.d30196cf6b28.back: The jaggery is added away from the fire so that the milk does not split.

seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and scrape the bottom each time you stir; milk catches easily during the long simmer.
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.t: स्थूलतलां स्थालीम् उपयोजयतु, प्रतिचालनं तलं च कर्षतु; दीर्घपाके दुग्धं सुकरं तले लगति।
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.back: Use a thick-bottomed pan, and scrape the bottom at every stirring; in long cooking milk easily sticks to the bottom.

seg.a01441abc0b6.src: Cook the rice until fully soft before the jaggery goes in; the grains do not soften further once it is sweetened.
seg.a01441abc0b6.t: गुडयोजनात् पूर्वं तण्डुलान् पूर्णतया मृदून् पचतु; मधुरीकरणात् परं कणाः अधिकं न मृदूभवन्ति।
seg.a01441abc0b6.back: Before adding the jaggery cook the rice fully soft; after sweetening, the grains do not soften any more.

seg.688b80a32383.src: Grate the jaggery finely so it melts in the hot milk without going back on the stove.
seg.688b80a32383.t: गुडं सूक्ष्मं घर्षयतु येन सः पुनः चुल्ल्यां न स्थापिते अपि उष्णदुग्धे विलीयेत।
seg.688b80a32383.back: Grate the jaggery fine so that it dissolves in the hot milk even without being placed on the stove again.

seg.7bf8faca62b8.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker colour and a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.7bf8faca62b8.t: तालगुडः: श्यामतरवर्णाय गभीरतर-धूमस्वादयुक्त-माधुर्याय च तावन्तम् एव घृष्टतालगुडम् उपयोजयतु।
seg.7bf8faca62b8.back: Palm jaggery: for a darker colour and a sweetness with deeper smoky taste, use the same amount of grated palm jaggery.

seg.6672d2210281.src: Pesarapappu paramannam: dry-roast 2 tbsp split moong dal until light golden, wash it and cook it with the rice.
seg.6672d2210281.t: पेसरपप्पु परमान्नम्: 2 महाचमसान् विभक्तमुद्गान् (मुद्गदालम्) तैलं विना ईषत्-स्वर्णवर्णपर्यन्तं भर्जयित्वा प्रक्षाल्य तण्डुलैः सह पचतु।
seg.6672d2210281.back: Pesarapappu paramannam: roast 2 big spoons of split moong (moong dal) without oil until slightly golden, wash, and cook with the rice.

seg.cd25d9fb2a56.src: Coconut: fry 2 tbsp thin slivers of dry coconut in the ghee along with the cashews.
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.t: नारिकेलम्: काजूतकैः सह घृते 2 महाचमसान् शुष्कनारिकेलस्य तनुखण्डान् भर्जयतु।
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.back: Coconut: roast 2 big spoons of thin pieces of dry coconut in ghee with the cashews.

seg.988ab75b5ccb.src: Serve warm as naivedyam at the Diwali or Lakshmi puja, then as the sweet at the festive meal. Some like it chilled the next day.
seg.988ab75b5ccb.t: दीपावल्यां लक्ष्मीपूजायां वा नैवेद्यरूपेण उष्णं परिवेषयतु, ततः उत्सवभोजने मिष्टान्नरूपेण। केचन परेद्युः शीतलं तत् इच्छन्ति।
seg.988ab75b5ccb.back: Serve warm as an offering (naivedya) at Deepavali or Lakshmi puja, then as the sweet at the festival meal. Some people like it cold the next day.

seg.4a60d211f14d.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. It sets thick when chilled; stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, before serving.
seg.4a60d211f14d.t: अवशिष्टम् आच्छाद्य शीतकपेटिकायां स्थापयतु, 2 दिनेषु खादतु च। शीतलं सत् घनं भवति; परिवेषणात् पूर्वम् अग्नेः दूरे किञ्चित् उष्णदुग्धं मिश्रयतु।
seg.4a60d211f14d.back: Cover the leftover, put it in the refrigerator, and eat within 2 days. When cold it becomes thick; before serving, mix in a little warm milk away from the fire.

seg.2949774c7efb.src: Why did my paramannam curdle after adding jaggery?
seg.2949774c7efb.back: Why did my paramannam split after adding jaggery?

seg.283626ae50fc.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still on the heat or boiling can make it split. Switch off, let the paramannam rest for about 5 minutes, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.283626ae50fc.t: अग्नौ स्थिते क्वथमाने वा दुग्धे मिश्रितः गुडः तत् भेत्तुं शक्नोति। अग्निं निर्वाप्य परमान्नं प्रायः 5 निमेषान् विश्रमयतु, ततः घृष्टगुडं मिश्रयतु।
seg.283626ae50fc.back: Jaggery mixed into milk that is on the fire or boiling can split it. Put out the fire, let the paramannam rest about 5 minutes, then mix in the grated jaggery.

seg.7df6976d1e83.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The paramannam turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7df6976d1e83.t: आम्। तावन्तम् एव घृष्टतालगुडम् (ताटि बेल्लम) उपयोजयतु। परमान्नं श्यामतरं भवति, तस्य स्वादः गभीरतरः ईषत्-धूमयुक्तः च।
seg.7df6976d1e83.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The paramannam becomes darker, its taste deeper and slightly smoky.

seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.src: Which rice is best for paramannam?
seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.back: Which rice is best for paramannam?

seg.ead18bc39c32.src: A short-grain rice such as sona masoori cooks soft and creamy in milk. Long-grain basmati keeps its grains separate and gives a thinner paramannam.
seg.ead18bc39c32.t: सोना मसूरी इत्यादयः ह्रस्वकणतण्डुलाः दुग्धे मृदवः घनाः च पच्यन्ते। दीर्घकण-बासमती-तण्डुलाः स्वकणान् पृथक् रक्षन्ति, तनुतरं परमान्नं च ददति।
seg.ead18bc39c32.back: Short-grain rice such as Sona Masoori cooks soft and thick in milk. Long-grain basmati rice keeps its grains separate, and gives a thinner paramannam.

seg.2baf5cc4ec36.src: How do I fix paramannam that has become too thick?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.t: अतिघनं जातं परमान्नं कथं सम्यक् करोमि?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.back: How do I fix paramannam that has become too thick?

seg.9ffeabf346fa.src: Stir in a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, until it loosens. It thickens as it cools, so stop when it is a little thinner than you want.
seg.9ffeabf346fa.t: अग्नेः दूरे कतिपयचमसमितम् उष्णदुग्धं मिश्रयतु यावत् तत् तरलं भवति। शीतलीभवत् तत् घनीभवति, अतः यदा इष्टात् किञ्चित् तनुतरं भवति तदा स्थगयतु।
seg.9ffeabf346fa.back: Away from the fire mix in a few spoonfuls of warm milk until it becomes liquid. As it cools it thickens, so stop when it is a little thinner than desired.

seg.8b09026bfd65.src: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. Bellam paramannam for Diwali: rice slow-cooked in milk and sweetened with cane jaggery off the heat, finished with ghee-fried cashews. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 4.
seg.8b09026bfd65.t: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. दीपावल्यै बेल्लम परमान्नम्: दुग्धे मन्दं पक्वाः तण्डुलाः, अग्नेः दूरे इक्षुगुडेन मधुरीकृताः, घृतभृष्टैः काजूतकैः समापिताः। क्रमशः विधिः, सूचनाः, प्रश्नोत्तराणि च। 4 जनेभ्यः।
seg.8b09026bfd65.back: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. Bellam paramannam for Deepavali: rice cooked slowly in milk, sweetened with cane jaggery away from the fire, finished with ghee-roasted cashews. Step-by-step method, tips, and questions-and-answers. For 4 people.

seg.cf8cab3618d9.t: बेल्लम परमान्नम्: 1acrefarms इत्यस्य पाकविधिपत्रम्, सामग्र्या विधिना च सह

seg.5fbc274b0656.src: Pasupu paalu is warm milk simmered with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then sweetened with jaggery. It is an everyday cup in many Telugu homes, made on cool evenings and often through Karthika masam, the month of Somavaram (Monday) pujas and evening lamps.
seg.5fbc274b0656.t: पसुपु पालु इति किञ्चित् हरिद्रया चिटिकामात्रेण कृष्णमरिचेन च सह मन्दं क्वथितम् उष्णदुग्धम्, ततः गुडेन मधुरीकृतम्। बहुषु तेलुगु-गृहेषु एषः दैनन्दिनः चषकः; शीतलसायङ्कालेषु क्रियते, प्रायः कार्तिकमासे च, यः सोमवासर-पूजानां सायन्दीपानां च मासः।
seg.5fbc274b0656.back: Pasupu paalu is warm milk gently simmered with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then sweetened with jaggery. In many Telugu homes it is a daily cup; it is made on cold evenings, and often in the month of Karthika, which is the month of Monday pujas and evening lamps.

seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.src: The turmeric turns the milk golden and gives it an earthy, slightly bitter edge, the pepper adds a little heat, and the jaggery rounds it off with a caramel sweetness. This recipe makes one cup in about 5 minutes.
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.t: हरिद्रा दुग्धं स्वर्णवर्णं करोति, तस्मै मृत्तिकासदृशं किञ्चित् तिक्तं स्वादं च ददाति; मरिचं किञ्चित् तीक्ष्णतां योजयति, गुडः च कैरमेल्-सदृशेन माधुर्येण तत् समापयति। अनेन पाकविधिना प्रायः 5 निमेषेषु एकः चषकः भवति।
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.back: Turmeric makes the milk golden-coloured, and gives it an earth-like, slightly bitter taste; pepper adds a little sharpness, and jaggery finishes it with a caramel-like sweetness. With this recipe one cup is made in about 5 minutes.

seg.8e4df121a859.src: Simmer milk with turmeric and a pinch of pepper, switch off, then stir in a spoon of jaggery.
seg.8e4df121a859.t: दुग्धं हरिद्रया चिटिकामात्रमरिचेन च सह मन्दं क्वाथयतु, अग्निं निर्वापयतु, ततः एकं चमसं गुडं मिश्रयतु।
seg.8e4df121a859.back: Gently simmer the milk with turmeric and a pinch of pepper, put out the fire, then mix in one spoon of jaggery.

seg.33cd5776caaf.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Turmeric Powder or Hill Turmeric Powder⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.back: ¼ small spoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧turmeric powder or hill-turmeric powder⟦/1⟧

seg.f1056c625241.src: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powdered or crushed⟦/1⟧
seg.f1056c625241.back: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powdered or pounded⟦/1⟧

seg.bc417c4b3691.src: 1 tsp grated palm or cane jaggery ⟦1⟧or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.t: 1 लघुचमसः घृष्टः तालगुडः इक्षुगुडः वा ⟦1⟧अथवा रुच्यनुसारम्⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.back: 1 small spoon grated palm jaggery or cane jaggery ⟦1⟧or according to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.1a51e1f06af0.src: Sweeten it with ⟦1⟧Palm Jaggery⟦/1⟧ or ⟦2⟧Cane Jaggery⟦/2⟧.

seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.src: Pour the milk into a small steel saucepan.
seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.back: Pour the milk into a small steel pan.

seg.94d57531a741.src: Add the turmeric and pepper (and the cardamom, if using) and stir until no specks of turmeric float on top. They mix in more evenly before the milk is heated.
seg.94d57531a741.t: हरिद्रां मरिचं च (एलां च, यदि उपयोजयति) योजयित्वा चालयतु यावत् उपरि हरिद्रायाः बिन्दवः न प्लवन्ते। दुग्धतापनात् पूर्वं तानि समानतरं मिश्र्यन्ते।
seg.94d57531a741.back: Adding the turmeric and pepper (and cardamom, if using), stir until no drops of turmeric float on top. Before heating the milk, they mix more evenly.

seg.9da3932c6508.src: Set the pan on medium-low heat. Warm the milk with the turmeric and pepper; simmer 2 minutes. Once small bubbles appear around the edge, turn the heat to low and let it bubble gently.
seg.9da3932c6508.t: स्थालीं मध्यम-मन्दाग्नौ स्थापयतु। दुग्धं हरिद्रामरिचाभ्यां सह तापयतु; 2 निमेषान् मन्दं क्वाथयतु। यदा परितः लघुबुद्बुदाः दृश्यन्ते, तदा अग्निं मन्दं कृत्वा मृदु बुद्बुदायितुं त्यजतु।
seg.9da3932c6508.back: Place the pan on medium-low fire. Heat the milk with the turmeric and pepper; gently simmer 2 minutes. When small bubbles are seen all around, make the fire low and leave it to bubble gently.

seg.c66cb9336ef5.src: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the pan, as milk rises fast once it boils. If it starts to climb, lift the pan off the heat for a few seconds.
seg.c66cb9336ef5.t: मध्ये मध्ये चालयतु, स्थालीं च पश्यतु, यतः क्वथनारम्भे दुग्धं शीघ्रम् उत्तिष्ठति। यदि तत् उद्गन्तुम् आरभते, तर्हि कतिपयक्षणान् स्थालीम् अग्नेः उद्धरतु।
seg.c66cb9336ef5.back: Stir now and then, and watch the pan, because at the start of boiling milk rises quickly. If it begins to rise up, then lift the pan off the fire for a few moments.

seg.b567bc0c93c9.src: It is ready when the milk is an even golden yellow and the raw smell of turmeric has gone.
seg.b567bc0c93c9.t: यदा दुग्धं समान-स्वर्णपीतवर्णं भवति, हरिद्रायाः आमगन्धः च गच्छति, तदा सिद्धम्।
seg.b567bc0c93c9.back: When the milk becomes an even golden-yellow colour, and the raw smell of turmeric goes, then it is ready.

seg.6e16c50d7c2a.src: Switch off and wait a minute. The milk drops just below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.t: अग्निं निर्वाप्य एकं निमेषं प्रतीक्षताम्। दुग्धं क्वथनात् किञ्चित् न्यूनतापं भवति, अतः गुडः तत् न भेत्स्यति।
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.back: Put out the fire and wait one minute. The milk becomes a little lower in heat than boiling, so the jaggery will not split it.

seg.aa0d1bcf6802.src: For a smooth cup, pour the milk through a fine sieve into a tumbler or mug.
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.t: मसृणचषकाय दुग्धं सूक्ष्मचालन्या टम्ब्लरे मग्-पात्रे वा पातयतु।
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.back: For a smooth cup, pour the milk through a fine sieve into a tumbler or mug vessel.

seg.862cac523844.src: Stir in the jaggery and serve warm. Stir for 20–30 seconds, until it dissolves, and taste for sweetness.
seg.862cac523844.t: गुडं मिश्रयित्वा उष्णं परिवेषयतु। विलयपर्यन्तं 20–30 क्षणान् चालयतु, माधुर्यं च आस्वादयतु।
seg.862cac523844.back: Having mixed in the jaggery, serve warm. Stir 20–30 seconds until dissolved, and taste the sweetness.

seg.1d9b9ec736a8.src: Strain through a fine sieve if you like it smooth.
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.back: If you want it smooth, strain with a fine sieve.

seg.018366193ef3.src: Add the jaggery only after switching off; jaggery stirred into boiling milk can split it.
seg.018366193ef3.t: अग्निं निर्वाप्य एव गुडं योजयतु; क्वथमाने दुग्धे मिश्रितः गुडः तत् भेत्तुं शक्नोति।
seg.018366193ef3.back: Add the jaggery only after putting out the fire; jaggery mixed into boiling milk can split it.

seg.0e783ba83473.src: Use a steel pan and spoon; turmeric stains plastic and wood.
seg.0e783ba83473.t: स्टील्-स्थालीं चमसं च उपयोजयतु; हरिद्रा प्लास्टिकं काष्ठं च रञ्जयति।
seg.0e783ba83473.back: Use a steel pan and spoon; turmeric stains plastic and wood.

seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.src: Making more? Use the same amounts for each cup of milk.
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.t: अधिकं करोति वा? प्रतिचषकदुग्धाय तानि एव परिमाणानि उपयोजयतु।
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.back: Making more? Use the same quantities for each cup of milk.

seg.485f68415013.src: Hill turmeric: use Hill Turmeric Powder (konda pasupu) in place of turmeric powder, in the same amount.
seg.485f68415013.t: गिरिहरिद्रा: हरिद्राचूर्णस्य स्थाने तावत् एव गिरिहरिद्राचूर्णं (कोण्डा पसुपु) उपयोजयतु।
seg.485f68415013.back: Hill turmeric: in place of turmeric powder use the same amount of hill-turmeric powder (konda pasupu).

seg.01ec7a142032.src: Palm or cane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness; cane jaggery a lighter, caramel one.
seg.01ec7a142032.t: तालगुडः इक्षुगुडः वा: तालगुडः गभीरतरम् ईषत्-धूमस्वादयुक्तं माधुर्यं ददाति; इक्षुगुडः लघुतरं कैरमेल्-सदृशं च।
seg.01ec7a142032.back: Palm jaggery or cane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deeper sweetness with a slight smoky taste; cane jaggery a lighter and caramel-like one.

seg.15b67235d087.src: Milder cup: leave out the pepper and add a pinch of cardamom powder instead.
seg.15b67235d087.t: मृदुतरः चषकः: मरिचं त्यक्त्वा तत्स्थाने चिटिकामात्रम् एलाचूर्णं योजयतु।
seg.15b67235d087.back: Milder cup: leaving out the pepper, add a pinch of cardamom powder in its place.

seg.d80219c8a51f.src: Serve warm in a tumbler or mug, on a cool evening or after the Karthika Somavaram puja.
seg.d80219c8a51f.t: टम्ब्लरे मग्-पात्रे वा उष्णं परिवेषयतु, शीतलसायङ्काले कार्तिकसोमवासर-पूजायाः अनन्तरं वा।
seg.d80219c8a51f.back: Serve warm in a tumbler or mug vessel, on a cold evening or after the Karthika Monday puja.

seg.ac04ffd1d51a.src: Make it as you need it and drink it warm. Reheating after the jaggery is in can split the milk.
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.t: आवश्यकतानुसारं कृत्वा उष्णम् एव पिबतु। गुडयोजनानन्तरं पुनस्तापनेन दुग्धं भिद्येत।
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.back: Make as needed and drink only warm. By reheating after adding jaggery, the milk may split.

seg.c758e61dd102.src: Why did my pasupu paalu curdle?
seg.c758e61dd102.back: Why did my pasupu paalu split?

seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Switch off the heat, wait about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.t: क्वथमाने दुग्धे मिश्रितः गुडः तत् भेत्तुं शक्नोति। अग्निं निर्वाप्य प्रायः एकं निमेषं प्रतीक्ष्य ततः घृष्टगुडं मिश्रयतु।
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.back: Jaggery mixed into boiling milk can split it. Put out the fire, wait about one minute, then mix in the grated jaggery.

seg.df4dbdd3102b.src: How much turmeric should I use for one cup of milk?
seg.df4dbdd3102b.back: How much turmeric should be used for one cup of milk?

seg.3ec50124bdd7.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder for 1 cup (about 240 ml) of milk. More than that makes the taste sharp and earthy.
seg.3ec50124bdd7.t: 1 चषकदुग्धाय (प्रायः 240 ml) ¼ लघुचमसः हरिद्राचूर्णम्। ततः अधिकेन स्वादः तीक्ष्णः मृत्तिकासदृशः च भवति।
seg.3ec50124bdd7.back: ¼ small spoon turmeric powder for 1 cup of milk (about 240 ml). With more than that, the taste becomes sharp and earth-like.

seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.src: Can I skip the black pepper?
seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.back: Can I leave out the black pepper?

seg.166b3a44e11d.src: Yes. The pepper adds a little heat to the taste; leave it out, or use a pinch of cardamom instead, for a milder cup.
seg.166b3a44e11d.t: आम्। मरिचं स्वादे किञ्चित् तीक्ष्णतां योजयति; मृदुतरचषकाय तत् त्यजतु, अथवा तत्स्थाने चिटिकामात्रम् एलाम् उपयोजयतु।
seg.166b3a44e11d.back: Yes. Pepper adds a little sharpness to the taste; for a milder cup leave it out, or use a pinch of cardamom in its place.

seg.2184adfd31b0.src: Should I use palm jaggery or cane jaggery?
seg.2184adfd31b0.back: Should palm jaggery be used, or cane jaggery?

seg.ef65c3a9d015.src: Either works, 1 tsp grated per cup. Palm jaggery tastes deeper and slightly smoky; cane jaggery is lighter and more like caramel.
seg.ef65c3a9d015.t: उभौ अपि उपयुक्तौ, प्रतिचषकं 1 लघुचमसः घृष्टः। तालगुडस्य स्वादः गभीरतरः ईषत्-धूमयुक्तः च; इक्षुगुडः लघुतरः कैरमेल्-सदृशतरः च।
seg.ef65c3a9d015.back: Both are suitable, 1 small spoon grated per cup. Palm jaggery's taste is deeper and slightly smoky; cane jaggery is lighter and more caramel-like.

seg.0f694f995bf8.back: పసుపు పాలు · Pasupu paalu (turmeric milk) recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.5094f960d9a4.back: In the Telugu kitchen, bellam usually means one of two: cheruku bellam, made from sugarcane juice, or tati bellam, made from the sap of the palm tree. FSSAI considers the two as separate products, and each has its own standard.

seg.13fd9611c493.back: In lump form the two look alike, but their taste is different, and they are suitable for different dishes. How to tell them apart, which to use where, and how to store them, is here. Below there is also a full Telugu section.

seg.70c115199d4c.src: Cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) is boiled-down sugarcane juice with a mellow, caramel sweetness: the one for payasam, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (thati bellam) is boiled-down palmyra sap, darker and deeper in taste: a favourite in filter coffee and tea. You can swap one for the other gram for gram; start with a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight jar.
seg.70c115199d4c.t: इक्षुगुडः (चेरुकु बेल्लम) क्वथनेन घनीकृतः इक्षुरसः, मृदुना कैरमेल्-सदृशेन माधुर्येण युक्तः: पायसाय, पोंगल्-इत्यस्मै, चिम्मिलि-इत्यस्मै च एषः। तालगुडः (ताटि बेल्लम) क्वथनेन घनीकृतः तालरसः, श्यामतरः गभीरतरस्वादः च: फिल्टर-काफ्यां चाये च प्रियः। एकस्य स्थाने अपरं ग्रामशः समभारेण उपयोक्तुं शक्यते; तालगुडं किञ्चित् न्यूनं गृहीत्वा आरभताम्। उभौ वायुरोधके पात्रे रक्षतु।
seg.70c115199d4c.back: Cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) is sugarcane juice thickened by boiling, with a gentle caramel-like sweetness: it is for payasam, for pongal, and for chimmili. Palm jaggery (tati bellam) is palm sap thickened by boiling, darker and of deeper taste: it is liked in filter coffee and in tea. One can be used in place of the other gram by gram at equal weight; start by taking a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight vessel.

seg.db3bddd4a4fc.src: Cane jaggery is made wherever sugarcane grows: the juice is pressed out of the cane and boiled down in open pans. In Andhra Pradesh, Anakapalli has the second largest jaggery market in India.
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.t: यत्र इक्षवः वर्धन्ते तत्र इक्षुगुडः क्रियते: इक्षुभ्यः रसः निष्पीड्य विवृतकटाहेषु क्वाथ्यते। आन्ध्रप्रदेशे अनकापल्ल्यां भारतस्य द्वितीया बृहत्तमा गुडविपणिः अस्ति।
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.back: Where sugarcane grows, there cane jaggery is made: juice is pressed from the cane and boiled in open pans. In Andhra Pradesh, at Anakapalli, there is India's second-largest jaggery market.

seg.31988f9e86fc.src: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palmyra palm, thati chettu in Telugu. The sap is called neera, or thati neera, and it is boiled down until it sets.
seg.31988f9e86fc.t: तालगुडः तालवृक्षस्य रसात् क्रियते, यः तेलुगुभाषायां ताटि चेट्टु इति कथ्यते। सः रसः नीरा अथवा ताटि नीरा इति उच्यते, घनीभवनपर्यन्तं क्वाथ्यते च।
seg.31988f9e86fc.back: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palm tree, which in the Telugu language is called tati chettu. That sap is called neera or tati neera, and is boiled until it thickens.

seg.46fffb385af6.src: Use the same weight. Palm jaggery tastes stronger, so start with a little less and add more to taste.

seg.46fffb385af6.back: Use equal weight. The taste of palm jaggery is stronger, so start with a little less and add more according to taste.

seg.8a98e07b6f1e.src: In milk, coffee or tea, add either jaggery after the milk is off the boil, so the milk does not split.
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.t: दुग्धे, काफ्यां, चाये वा, दुग्धे क्वथनात् अवतारिते एव कमपि गुडं योजयतु, येन दुग्धं न भिद्येत।
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.back: In milk, coffee or tea, add any jaggery only when the milk is taken off boiling, so that the milk does not split.

seg.6788faade30c.src: Keep jaggery in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place.

seg.6788faade30c.back: Keep jaggery in an airtight vessel in a cool, dry place.

seg.5ea00ae441ac.src: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery takes in moisture from the air and turns sticky.

seg.5ea00ae441ac.back: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery takes moisture from the air, and becomes sticky.

seg.cc5783126657.src: Is palm jaggery the same as karupatti?
seg.cc5783126657.t: तालगुडः करुप्पट्टि च एकम् एव किम्?
seg.cc5783126657.back: Are palm jaggery and karupatti one and the same?

seg.f7071649dddd.src: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name for jaggery made from palmyra sap. In Telugu it is thati bellam, and in Hindi taad ka gud.
seg.f7071649dddd.t: आम्। तालरसात् कृतस्य गुडस्य तमिऴ्-नाम करुप्पट्टि। तेलुगुभाषायां सः ताटि बेल्लम, हिन्दीभाषायां च ताड़ का गुड़।
seg.f7071649dddd.back: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name of jaggery made from palm sap. In the Telugu language it is tati bellam, and in the Hindi language taad ka gud.

seg.a591ce90fac8.src: Is gud the same as jaggery?
seg.a591ce90fac8.back: Are 'gud' and guda (jaggery) one and the same?

seg.9e04d6270c92.src: Yes. Gud, or gur, is the Hindi word for jaggery, and bellam is the Telugu one. On its own it usually means cane jaggery.
seg.9e04d6270c92.t: आम्। गुड़, अथवा गुर, गुडस्य हिन्दीशब्दः, बेल्लम च तेलुगुशब्दः। केवलं प्रयुक्तः सः प्रायः इक्षुगुडं सूचयति।
seg.9e04d6270c92.back: Yes. Gud, or gur, is the Hindi word for jaggery, and bellam the Telugu word. Used alone, it usually indicates cane jaggery.

seg.e531a25812a8.src: Why has my jaggery gone sticky?
seg.e531a25812a8.back: Why has my jaggery become sticky?

seg.cc79285bfadd.src: It has taken in moisture from the air, which happens faster in humid weather. Move it to an airtight jar and use a dry spoon.

seg.cc79285bfadd.back: It has taken moisture from the air, which happens faster in a humid season. Move it to an airtight vessel and use a dry spoon.

seg.8ba95d799ac9.src: Yes. It gives a darker colour and a deeper taste. Add it off the heat, as you would cane jaggery.

seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI-मानकं वदति यत् हरिद्राचूर्णं योजितैः रञ्जकद्रव्यैः, लेड-क्रोमेट इत्यनेन सह, बाह्यश्वेतसारेण च रहितं भवेत्। तस्य परीक्षणपुस्तिका निरीक्षकाः हरिद्रायां यत् परीक्षन्ते तत् सूचयति: मेटानिल्-येलो इत्यादयः योजिताः रञ्जकाः, सीसलवणानि, खटिकाचूर्णं च।
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: The FSSAI standard says that turmeric powder should be free of added colouring substances, including lead chromate, and of external starch. Its testing manual indicates what inspectors test for in turmeric: added colourants such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: एतेषु किञ्चित् भवान् पाकशालायां परीक्षितुं शक्नोति, किञ्चित् तु केवलं प्रयोगशाला एव ज्ञातुं शक्नोति। एषा मार्गदर्शिका उभयं वर्णयति, तथा द्वे प्रसिद्धे परीक्षे अपि ये हरिद्रायै न कार्यं कुरुतः। भवान् यां कामपि हरिद्रां क्रीणाति, तस्याम् एताः परीक्षाः करोतु, अस्माकं हरिद्रायाम् अपि।
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these you can test in the kitchen, but some only a laboratory can detect. This guide describes both, and also two well-known tests that do not work for turmeric. Do these tests on whatever turmeric you buy, on our turmeric too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: हरिद्रापरीक्षायाः अनन्तरं जलस्य द्वे काचपात्रे। वामे: तले स्थितचूर्णेन सह पाण्डुपीतं जलम्। दक्षिणे: चूर्णात् अधः प्रवहन्तीभिः पीतरेखाभिः सह गाढपीतं जलम्।
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glass vessels of water after the turmeric test. On the left: pale yellow water with powder settled at the bottom. On the right: deep yellow water with yellow streaks flowing down from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧जलपरीक्षा⟦/1⟧वामे: चूर्णं तले स्थितम्, जलं च पाण्डुपीतम्। दक्षिणे: निमज्जतः चूर्णात् गाढपीतरेखाः प्रावहन्, जलं च गाढपीतं जातम्। तत् प्रयोगशालापरीक्षायोग्यम्।
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧Water test⟦/1⟧On the left: the powder settled at the bottom, and the water pale yellow. On the right: deep yellow streaks flowed from the sinking powder, and the water became deep yellow. That is fit for laboratory testing.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: एकं लघुचमसं हरिद्रां जलपूर्णे काचपात्रे प्रकिरतु, अचालयित्वा स्थिरीभवितुं त्यजतु। हरिद्रा निमज्जति, जलं च पाण्डुपीतं त्यजति; यत् जलं तत्क्षणं गाढपीतं भवति, तत् योजितवर्णं सूचयति। एषा परीक्षा लेड-क्रोमेटं खटिकां वा ज्ञातुं न शक्नोति, अतः निश्चितोत्तराय खाद्यपरीक्षणप्रयोगशालाम् उपयोजयतु। आयोडीन-परीक्षां त्यजतु: हरिद्रायां मूलतः एव श्वेतसारः अस्ति।
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle one small spoon of turmeric onto a glass vessel full of water, and leave it to settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that immediately becomes deep yellow indicates added colour. This test cannot detect lead chromate or chalk, so for a definite answer use a food testing laboratory. Skip the iodine test: turmeric has starch from the root (from the root itself).

seg.9b20e15186d4.back: What FSSAI tests for in turmeric

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: यथा मेटानिल्-येलो, यत् निष्प्रभां हरिद्रां दीप्ततरां दर्शयितुं शक्नोति। FSSAI हरिद्रायां योजितवर्णं न अनुमन्यते।
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric appear brighter. FSSAI does not permit added colour in turmeric.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other lead salts

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड-क्रोमेट वर्णलेपे उपयुज्यमानः पीतवर्णकः। स्टैनफर्ड-नेतृत्वे 2019 तमे 2024 तमे च वर्षे प्रकाशितैः अध्ययनैः दक्षिण-एशियायाः केषुचित् भागेषु हरिद्रायां सः प्राप्तः। FSSAI हरिद्रायां तं सर्वथा न अनुमन्यते।
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Through Stanford-led studies published in the years 2019 and 2024, it was found in turmeric in some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not permit it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A low-priced white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: अन्यसस्यानां पिष्टं श्वेतसारः वा। FSSAI-मानकं तम् अपि निषेधति।
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. The FSSAI standard forbids that too.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a transparent glass vessel with water of room temperature.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: उपरि एकं समतलं लघुचमसं हरिद्राचूर्णं प्रकिरतु। मा चालयतु।
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle one level small spoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: चूर्णे निमज्जति सति प्रथमं निमेषं पश्यतु। तस्मात् अधः प्रवहन्तीः वर्णरेखाः अन्विष्यतु।
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: While the powder sinks, watch the first minute. Look for colour streaks flowing down from it.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 तः 20 निमेषान् यावत् त्यजतु। ततः काचपात्रं श्वेतभित्तेः पत्रस्य वा पुरतः धृत्वा स्थितचूर्णस्य उपरि जलं पश्यतु।
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then, holding the glass vessel in front of a white wall or a sheet, look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.7253b4d90896.back: There is no sign of added colourant.

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गाढपीतरेखाः, अथवा निमेषेषु एव गाढपीतं जलम्
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Deep yellow streaks, or deep yellow water within minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: योजितवर्णः सम्भवति। तस्य बैचस्य उपयोगं स्थगयतु, तत् परीक्षयतु च।
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Added colour is possible. Stop using that batch, and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧किमर्थम् एतत् कार्यं करोति।⟦/1⟧ हरिद्रायाः स्वकीयः पीतवर्णः, कर्क्युमिन्, जले प्रायः न विलीयते, अतः चूर्णं निमज्जति जलं च केवलम् ईषत् रञ्जयति। मेटानिल्-येलो इत्यादयः रञ्जकाः सुकरं विलीयन्ते जलं च शीघ्रं रञ्जयन्ति।
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and colours the water only slightly. Colourants such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧किं न ज्ञायते।⟦/1⟧ लेड-क्रोमेट खटिका च अपि जले न विलीयेते, अतः ताभ्यां मिश्रिता हरिद्रा एतां परीक्षाम् उत्तरेत्। केवलं प्रयोगशालापरीक्षा एव ते निराकर्तुं शक्नोति।
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What is not detected.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them would pass this test. Only a laboratory test can rule them out.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: अतिसूक्ष्मं चूर्णं कञ्चित् कालं जलम् आविलं रक्षेत्। आविलं जलं न दोषः; पारदर्शकं गाढपीतं जलम् एव द्रष्टव्यम्।
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Very fine powder may keep the water cloudy for some time. Cloudy water is not a fault; only transparent deep yellow water is what is to be watched for.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Test 2: If you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: शुष्कहरिद्रायाः एकम् अङ्गुलिखण्डं द्विधा भनक्तु। हरिद्रा आद्यन्तं पीत-नारङ्गवर्णा, अतः अन्तर्भागः बहिर्भागसदृशः एव दृश्येत। पाण्डुवर्णस्य निष्प्रभस्य वा अन्तर्भागस्य उपरि दीप्तपीता त्वक् पृष्ठे वर्णः योजितः इति सूचयेत्। विक्रेतारं तद्विषये पृच्छतु, अथवा तत् परीक्षयतु।
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break one finger-piece of dry turmeric in two. Turmeric is yellow-orange from beginning to end, so the inner part should look just like the outer part. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull inner part would indicate that colour was added on the surface. Ask the seller about that, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: आयोडीन श्वेतसारेण संयुक्तं नील-कृष्णवर्णं भवति, हरिद्रायां पिष्टस्य अन्वेषणाय च प्रायः सूच्यते। किन्तु हरिद्रा स्वयं श्वेतसारयुक्ता, अतः उभयथा अपि नील-कृष्णा भवति। अत एव FSSAI इत्यस्य स्वीया पुस्तिका हरिद्रां विहाय अन्येषु चूर्णितमसालेषु आयोडीन-परीक्षाम् उपयुङ्क्ते।
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine combined with starch becomes blue-black in colour, and it is often suggested for detecting flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself contains starch, so it becomes blue-black either way. For that very reason FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test on ground spices other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: हरिद्रायां सीसस्य, मेटानिल्-येलो इत्यस्य, खटिकायाः च FSSAI-परीक्षाः सान्द्रं हाइड्रोक्लोरिक-अम्लं सल्फ्यूरिक-अम्लं वा उपयुञ्जते। एते अम्लाः त्वचं नेत्रे च दहन्ति। ते प्रयोगशालायाम् एव उचिताः, न पाकशालायाम्।
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric acid or sulphuric acid. These acids burn the skin and the eyes. They are proper only in a laboratory, not in the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a definite answer: a food testing laboratory

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL-मान्यताप्राप्ता खाद्यपरीक्षणप्रयोगशाला हरिद्रायां सीसं योजितवर्णान् च परीक्षितुं शक्नोति। प्रयोगशालां पृच्छतु कियान् प्रतिदर्शः आवश्यकः, चूर्णं तस्य मुद्राबद्धे पुटके स्वच्छे मुद्राबद्धे स्यूते वा रक्षतु, पुटके मुद्रितां बैच-सङ्ख्यां च लिखतु। FSSAI स्वजालस्थाने अधिसूचितानां खाद्यपरीक्षणप्रयोगशालानां सूचीं प्रकाशयति।
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing laboratory can test turmeric for lead and added colours. Ask the laboratory how much sample is needed, keep the powder in its sealed packet or in a clean sealed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the packet. FSSAI publishes the list of notified food testing laboratories on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI अनुज्ञापत्रसङ्ख्या पञ्जीकरणसङ्ख्या वा। ताम् FSSAI इत्यस्य FoSCoS जालस्थाने अन्वेष्टुं शक्नोति।
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: An FSSAI licence number or registration number. You can search it on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: येन निर्मितं पुटीकृतं वा तस्य नाम सङ्केतः च।
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: The name and address of the one by whom it was made or packed.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: निवलपरिमाणम्, MRP, बैच-सङ्ख्या लॉट-सङ्ख्या वा, श्रेष्ठोपयोगतिथिः च।
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch number or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: कुत्र उत्पादितम्। भिन्नप्रदेशानां हरिद्रा वर्णे भिद्यते, अतः नामाङ्कितः प्रदेशः समानस्य समानेन तुलनायां साहाय्यं करोति।
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was produced. Turmeric of different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps in comparing like with like.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: पुटकं जिप् बद्धं रक्षतु, अथवा चूर्णं शुष्कं वायुरोधकं पात्रं प्रति नयतु।
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the packet zip closed, or move the powder into a dry, airtight vessel.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: शुष्कं चमसम् उपयोजयतु। आर्द्रः चमसः एव हरिद्रां पिण्डितां करोति।
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. It is a wet spoon that makes turmeric lumpy.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: तां साक्षात् सूर्यातपात् दूरे रक्षतु, यः वर्णं म्लानयति।
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep it away from direct sunlight, which fades the colour.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: न स्वयमेव। वर्णः प्रकारेण, उत्पत्तिस्थानेन, शोषण-पेषण-रीत्या च परिवर्तते, अतः हरिद्राः बहु भिद्यन्ते। द्रष्टव्यं तु एतत् यत् वर्णः चूर्णात् अतिसुकरं निर्गच्छति वा न वा, यथा जलपरीक्षायाम्।
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not by itself. The colour changes with the variety, the place of origin, and the method of drying and grinding, so turmerics differ a lot. What is to be seen is whether the colour comes out of the powder very easily or not, as in the water test.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: हरिद्रायां सीसं नास्ति इति जलपरीक्षा दर्शयितुं शक्नोति किम्?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can the water test show that there is no lead in turmeric?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: न। लेड-क्रोमेट जले न विलीयते, अतः जलपरीक्षा तं द्रष्टुं न शक्नोति। केवलं प्रयोगशालापरीक्षा एव शक्नोति।
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water test cannot see it. Only a laboratory test can.

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: आर्द्रता। आर्द्रः चमसः विवृतं पुटकं वा चूर्णं जलं ग्राहयति। शुष्कचमसेन पिण्डान् भनक्तु, पुटकं च बद्धं रक्षतु।
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open packet makes the powder absorb water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon, and keep the packet closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: यदि काचित् परीक्षा अनुचिता दृश्यते, तर्हि किं करवाणि?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: If some test appears improper, then what should I do?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.

seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the packet, contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report through FSSAI's Food Safety Connect application. If it is our turmeric, then send us a picture of the packet and the glass vessel through WhatsApp.
